name: Carnage Cliff
detailed_description:
If you play other games as a medic, this game is for you!

DEMO available!

The game is very simple and linear and with an interesting story: a soldier must protect his companions during an assault on enemy troops who have taken their general hostage. However, the mission will not be easy as the enemies are resistant and become greater in number as you get closer to the final objective.

Heal your teammates

Use morphine shots or bandages to get your teammates back to fight and advance deeper into the enemy territory.

Get powerful upgrades

Collect experience points during the battle and use them to upgrade these properties:

  • Chance to do critical damage

  • Consistently higher damage

  • Higher healing efficiency

Search for bonuses that make your team overpowered!

During the battles, it is possible to recover objects in search spaces scattered around the map which include temporary invulnerability.

Enjoy a story

In addition to all this, every time a level is completed, letters appear addressed to the player from various characters who are waiting for him at home and are worried about not seeing him again. All these elements make the game very interesting as you do not just go around a random map, but you have a story that gives depth to the character.

Get a unique game experience

The teammates attack the enemies and take cover if they are losing too much health by hiding behind trees or other cover. The player must assist them so that they return to the fight. However, when their health level is too low or you have no more resources, you must take them to the safe zone at the beginning of the map and lower them down the cliff to safety. If you are not quick in doing so, a timer will expire, indicating that the enemy troops will advance eliminating every survivor in the trenches. To finish the level, you have two possibilities:

  • Save the general

  • Retreat and try again with upgraded teammates

Enjoy new level every day

There is a new level every day with different layouts, different challenges, and difficulties ranging from easy to almost impossible, which makes the game replayable for a very long period.

Features

  • A game element never seen before: hormone system

  • Simple linear graphics with bright colors

  • Music that accompanies the player well

  • Noises well placed

  • Purchasable bonuses that can be used immediately

  • Intuitive and easy-to-understand game controls

  • Good explanations of the controls through cartoons

  • Excellent narrative through letters that are unlocked as you progress through the game

  • Daily levels

Planned additions

  • Daily challenges

  • Achievements

  • Enemy variety

  • Environment variety

  • New biomes

  • Better animations of important in-game events

  • Difficulty settings

  • More music

short_description: In this battle game you won't shoot a single bullet. Your job will be to heal your teammates and upgrade them so that together you reach the end of a level and rescue a captured general.A great game to spend a couple of minutes on every day.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel I3
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel I5
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Resolution at least 1600x900
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Blood. A lot of blood and scatered body parts of defeated enemies.
